qaPairs.question: Does CyberGOAT provide official EC-Council exam vouchers?
qaPairs.answer: Yes! As an official EC-Council Authorized Reseller and Training Partner, CyberGOAT provides official EC-Council exam vouchers, official courseware, and hands-on iLabs access with every EC-Council course (CEH v12, C|CISO, CHFI, CND, CPENT).

qaPairs.question: What is included in the CEH v12 training program?
qaPairs.answer: The CEH v12 (Certified Ethical Hacker) program includes 40 hours of instructor-led live training, official EC-Council iLabs access for 6 months, official EC-Council courseware, and 1 official CEH exam voucher.

qaPairs.question: Which data privacy certifications do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: We offer CIPP/E (Certified Information Privacy Professional/Europe), CIPM (Certified Information Privacy Manager), DPO (Data Protection Officer) Training, and compliance workshops on EU GDPR, UAE PDPL, and DESC ISR.

qaPairs.question: Where is CyberGOAT located in Dubai?
qaPairs.answer: CyberGOAT is located in Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO-IFZA), Digital Park, Building A1, Dubai, UAE. You can reach our team directly at +971 55 184 6786 or admin@cybergoat.ae.

qaPairs.question: What training formats are available?
qaPairs.answer: We offer 3 flexible learning formats: 1) Online Live Interactive Sessions, 2) In-Person Dubai Bootcamps at our training center, and 3) Custom Corporate Enterprise Team Upskilling.

qaPairs.question: What is the C|CISO course and who should take it?
qaPairs.answer: The C|CISO (Certified Chief Information Security Officer) program is designed for senior security executives and IT leaders covering Governance, Risk Management, Audit, and Executive Leadership. Includes official C|CISO voucher.
